summary.text: Nicole Poore has represented Delaware Senate District 12 since 2012 and served as Senate Majority Leader from 2019 to 2021.

paragraphs.text: According to her official page, Poore was raised in New Castle, graduated from St. Elizabeth's High School in 1990, and holds degrees in criminal justice from Delaware Technical Community College and Wilmington University and a master's in organizational leadership from Wilmington University.
The page says she is president of Jobs for Delaware Graduates and lives in New Castle.
